  [113]=function(b,k) return (b+k*7)%256 end,
  [74]=function(b,k) k=k%8 if k==0 then return b end local lo=b%(2^k) local hi=math.floor(b/(2^k)) return (lo*(2^(8-k))+hi)%256 end,
  [208]=function(b,k) local r,p,a,c=0,1,b,k while a>0 or c>0 do local ab,cb=a%2,c%2 if ab~=cb then r=r+p end a=(a-ab)/2 c=(c-cb)/2 p=p*2 end return r end,
  [69]=function(b,k) return (b*k+1)%256 end,
  [25]=function(b) return ((b%16)*16)+math.floor(b/16) end,
  [102]=function(b,k) return (b-k+256)%256 end,
  [220]=function(b) return 255-b end
}
local SEQ={102}
local CN=1
local i,n=1,#_O100
while i<=n do
  local keys={}
  for c=1,CN do keys[c]=_O100[i] i=i+1 end
  local val=_O100[i] i=i+1
  for c=CN,1,-1 do val=OPFN[SEQ[c]](val,keys[c]) end
  _l1ll[#_l1ll+1]=_0lll(val)
end
local __src=_IOOI(_l1ll)
local __cs=0
for k=1,#__src do __cs=(__cs*131+string.byte(__src,k))%65536 end
if #__src~=_l1O0 or __cs~=_IIll then error("MEEN HUB VM: integrity check failed (len "..#__src.."/".._l1O0..", checksum "..__cs.."/".._IIll..")") end
local __f,__ferr
if load then __f,__ferr=load(__src) end
if not __f and loadstring then __f,__ferr=loadstring(__src) end
if not __f then error("MEEN HUB VM: decoded chunk failed to compile -> "..tostring(__ferr)) end
-- MEMORY HYGIENE: drop every reference to the plaintext decoded source and
-- the raw instruction buffers now that it's compiled, then nudge the
-- collector, so a memory scanner that runs AFTER this point has nothing
-- left to find. (Can't do anything about a debugger already attached
-- before this line ran -- nothing running inside the sandbox can.)
_10I1,_O100,_l1ll,__src=nil,nil,nil,nil
if collectgarbage then pcall(collectgarbage,"collect") end
return __f()
